about.description: Version 2 (2026-09-05; computing groups appended 2026-09-06; the skilled trades, optional, 2026-10-07). One family per ISCO-08 unit group of the vertical (minor groups 214-216, 251-252, 311-315 and 351-352, minus product/garment and graphic designers; optional: 712 (plumbing and air conditioning only), 721-723 (without bicycle repairers) and 741-742), grouped by minor group. id = the ISCO code; label = what the screen shows under the group heading, es and ca = the same in Spanish and Catalan; a group with optional: true shows its offers only to a visitor who picks one of its families; isco_title = ISCO/ESCO's own title; extra_terms = job titles ESCO lacks, per language (all of Catalan; the English of company boards; a few Spanish). The gate reads the job titles per language from codes/isco.json (ESCO) and the SSYK correspondence from codes/ssyk-isco.json (JobTech). APPEND ONLY: the position of a family is its bit in the profile code. Built by builder/tools/make-families.mjs.
